summary: The DestProfilePRHistory is a web user control in the HSPnet application. It handles displaying and interacting with instructor PR (Professional Record) history. The control includes functionalities such as searching, displaying details, and printing reports related to the instructor's PR history.
purpose: To manage and display the history of instructor professional records within the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: PR History Item Command Handling
steps: Listen for commands from the PR history repeater item.
Data-bind the repeater on specific commands (cmdStart, cmdCourse, cmdToSite, cmdStatus).
Toggle CSS class for cmdDetails button based on current state.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Initialize session and prepare UI components on page load.

workflows.name: Data Selection
steps: On data selection, check for user session availability.
If session is available, provide session and other related parameters for data retrieval.

workflows.name: Item Data Binding
steps: Bind data to UI controls depending on the item type.
Modify visibility and CSS styles of controls based on conditions like alternate observation and item data.

conditions: User session should be available for data selection.
PR ID should be greater than 0 and user should not be 'Course Leader Only' for cmdDetails to be visible.
trRow and other rows visibility depend on the ParentPRDID and whether the item is an alternating item.
system_behavior: Repeater data binding and command handling are central to interaction.
Visibility of UI components depends on user roles and permissions.
CSS classes toggle to display different icons based on actions.
